page.title: Illegal Soccer Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions on Ball Control and Gear
page.description_md: Think you know Illegal Soccer? Test your ball control and match gear knowledge. Each attempt draws 15 random questions, five from each difficulty, with no timer.
page.seo_description: Answer 15 questions on the Roblox game Illegal Soccer, five at each difficulty, on ball control, gear and match rules. There's no timer, so take your time.

easy.question: How do you pick up the loose ball in the tutorial's first task?

options.text: Stand beside it without making contact.
Walk into it to make contact.
Call for it from your teammate.
Hit the opponent standing next to it.

easy.question: In the tutorial's teamwork task, what does Pass do?

options.text: Keep the ball attached to you.
Call for the ball from its carrier.
Send the ball to your teammate.
Move you sideways with the ball.

easy.question: What does Lob do in the tutorial's teamwork task?

options.text: Send the ball high over a defender.
Roll the ball low between a defender's feet.
Keep the ball at your feet while shifting sideways.
Pull a loose ball backward away from a defender.

easy.question: What does Request Ball ask the player with possession to do?

options.text: Hold the ball until you reach them.
Send the ball to the opposing keeper.
Keep the ball and start a shot.
Send the ball back to you.

easy.question: After you pick up the ball, what does the tutorial's first task ask you to do next?

options.text: Carry it back to its starting spot.
Kick it forward across the pitch.
Keep holding it beside the teammate.
Leave it untouched for the next player.

easy.question: In the tutorial's attack task, you have landed the held Kick on the opponent. Which action completes the sequence?

options.text: Hit them with another held Kick.
Use an equipped item against them.
Dribble past them with the ball.
Slide into them to trip them.

easy.question: What does Automatic Item Use change about activating an item?

options.text: Items need another manual use input.
Items wait until the next box pickup.
Items activate without a separate use input.
Items wait until the next goal is scored.

easy.question: While defending as goalkeeper, what does Dive help you do?

options.text: Move across the goalmouth faster and reach high shots.
Release a caught ball toward an open teammate.
Send a lofted clearance out across the pitch.
Strike a nearby attacker with a melee hit.

easy.question: After taking the tutorial's question-mark box, what must you do with the item it gives you?

options.text: Equip it, then use it as prompted.
Equip it, then keep it unused until scoring.
Leave it unequipped until the tutorial ends.
Leave it unequipped and collect another box.

easy.question: How do you take the goalkeeper role when it is available?

options.text: Stand beside a question-mark box on the pitch.
Stand in the center circle before a kickoff.
Step into the rectangle in front of the net.
Step onto a team pad back in the lobby.

easy.question: With Assisted Passes enabled, where does a pass track instead of drifting into empty space?

options.text: Toward the nearest opposing player.
Toward a nearby teammate.
Toward the center of your own goal.
Toward the next question-mark box.

easy.question: How many question-mark boxes are on the pitch at one time?

options.text: Two, with a separate box for each team.
One for every player currently on the pitch.
None, because boxes appear only in the lobby.
One, shared between both teams contesting it.

medium.question: What is the trade-off of a fully charged Kick?

options.text: Less distance, but easier placement.
More distance, with easier placement.
Less distance, with harder placement.
More distance, but harder placement.

medium.question: In a live match, what does touching a question-mark box give you?

options.text: One usable item from your equipped loadout.
One permanent unlock from the entire shop pool.
A complete set of every item in your loadout.
A permanent copy of the opponent's equipped item.

medium.question: After the earlier tutorial tasks, which three goals finish its final task?

options.text: Three you score, excluding teammate goals and own goals.
Three your team scores, including your teammates' goals.
Three you score, including goals into your own net.
Three either team scores, regardless of who scores them.

medium.question: Before an opponent's shot arrives, what does its blue aim line and target dot show the keeper?

options.text: Where to stand to begin protection from attacks.
Which teammate is available as a passing target.
Where the shot is headed on the goal line.
Which loose ball to collect beside the goal.

medium.question: With Grenade equipped, what does its dotted arc indicate?

options.text: Where an opponent's next shot will reach the goal.
The Grenade's projected landing spot on the pitch.
Where the next question-mark box will appear.
The position a nearby teammate will run toward.

medium.question: For six seconds after a goalkeeper catches the ball, what protection applies?

options.text: Their next shot cannot be intercepted.
Their teammates cannot lose possession.
Opponents cannot enter the goal area.
The goalkeeper cannot be attacked.

medium.question: When you time Dribble against an opponent's incoming tackle while carrying the ball, what do you gain besides keeping possession?

options.text: A refill of the equipped item slots.
A speed boost after the contact.
Protection from every later tackle.
A stronger charge on your next shot.

medium.question: Who can slip on the Oil Spill you place?

options.text: You and opponents, while your teammates are protected.
Your opponents, while your own side is protected.
You and your teammates, as well as opponents.
Your teammates and opponents, while you are protected.

hard.question: What happens to Flick while a tackle animation is still playing?

options.text: It is blocked only for the first part of the animation.
It is blocked only for the last part of the animation.
It is blocked until you press Flick again mid-animation.
It is blocked throughout the whole tackle animation.

hard.question: What sequence happens when you use Sledgehammer?

options.text: You stay grounded, swing sideways, and launch the ball toward goal.
You launch upward, slam the turf, and ragdoll nearby foes.
You launch upward, swing in midair, and knock one foe downward.
You stay grounded, slam the turf, and pull nearby foes inward.

hard.question: You leap and time a Pass volley as the airborne ball arrives. What is this volley suited for?

options.text: A power finish built for the longest range.
A lofted chip over a keeper off the line.
An accurate redirect built for close range.
A low reset that pins the ball at your feet.

hard.question: After a sprinting forward flick and an immediate jump, when do you start the slide to add distance and hide the kick animation?

options.text: While descending from the jump toward the pitch.
While first rising away from the pitch.
Before your feet leave the pitch for the jump.
After your feet have landed back on the pitch.

hard.question: For the wall-volley technique, what movement and rebound timing do you use before the shot?

options.text: Stop, volley into the sidewall, and take the rebound before it lands.
Keep moving, volley into the sidewall, and let the rebound land.
Stop, volley into the sidewall, and take the rebound after it lands.
Keep moving, volley into the sidewall, and take the rebound before it lands.
